description: This file provides utilities for managing and querying cgroup modes, mounts, subsystems, and related operations in Linux, including functions for reading cgroup files, removing cgroup paths, and converting resource limits between cgroup v1 and v2.

classes.name: Mount
classes.description: Represents a cgroup mount point with its root and subsystems.

methods.name: IsCgroup2UnifiedMode
methods.description: Checks if the system is running in cgroup v2 unified mode.

methods.name: IsCgroup2HybridMode
methods.description: Checks if the system is running in cgroup v2 hybrid mode.

methods.name: GetCgroupMounts
methods.description: Returns the cgroup mounts, either all or the first instance.

methods.name: GetAllSubsystems
methods.description: Returns all supported cgroup subsystems supported by the kernel.

methods.name: ParseCgroupFile
methods.description: Parses a cgroup file into a map of subsystems to cgroup paths.

methods.name: GetPids
methods.description: Returns all PIDs added to a cgroup at a specified path.

methods.name: WriteCgroupProc
methods.description: Writes a PID into the cgroup's cgroup.procs file.

methods.name: ConvertCPUSharesToCgroupV2Value
methods.description: Converts CPU shares (cgroup v1) to CPU weight (cgroup v2).

methods.name: ConvertMemorySwapToCgroupV2Value
methods.description: Converts MemorySwap value from OCI spec for cgroup v2.

methods.name: ConvertBlkIOToIOWeightValue
methods.description: Converts blkio weight (cgroup v1) to IO weight (cgroup v2).
